frontier.hypothesis: The one-word Makefile:136 edit (RODATA_ALIGN2_FILES += text1b) plus the two banked src patches take func_800747D8 to COMPLETED-C with no further technical work.
frontier.mechanism: Proven this session by full-build SHA1. The three edits are banked verbatim as memory/grind/func_800747D8/integration/text1b.c.patch, text1a_b_mid_rodata.c.patch and the two .proven full-file copies; the Makefile change is a single word appended to an existing 13-entry list whose mechanism (Makefile:146 rodata_align_fix) has shipped since before this ledger existed.
frontier.next_probe: Operator: apply the Makefile word (filed as a row in docs/grind/owner_actions.md). Driver: on a Judge ESCALATE(integration-handoff), grant src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c into tools/grinder/scope_allow.txt. Then the next session applies all three patches, runs layer-1 + Judge + the full build, and calls `queue done func_800747D8`.

frontier.hypothesis: Other queued functions are stuck on exactly this alignment gate — a 4-mod-8 jump-table address in a TU that is not on RODATA_ALIGN2_FILES.
frontier.mechanism: tools/gcc-2.7.2/final.c:1512-1518's unconditional `.align 3` vs the original toolchain's 4-byte tables: 40 of the binary's 65 jump tables are 4 mod 8, and only 13 source files currently opt into the sed fix.
frontier.next_probe: Run tmp/grind/func_800747D8/s10/jtbl_align_census.py, cross-reference each 4-mod-8 table's owning function against engine/queue.json and against RODATA_ALIGN2_FILES at Makefile:136, and flag any queued function whose file is missing from the list. That is a cheap sweep that may unblock several items at once.

frontier.hypothesis: The duplicated `sound = 4;` could be replaced by a single-assignment spelling that still puts a CODE_LABEL between the assignment and the test, removing the need to claim duplicated-statement-into-arms at all.
frontier.mechanism: The gate is purely tools/gcc-2.7.2/rtlanal.c:886-888's CODE_LABEL stop feeding tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:1178. s9's V4 proved a `break`-converged switch puts the label on the wrong side (score 10/205), but other shapes (one arm assigning and the other reaching the block by a goto that skips the assignment; an enclosing if guarding only the assignment) are still unenumerated.
frontier.next_probe: Only worth spending if layer-1 or the Judge objects to the family claim — the claim is fully documented in self_vet.md with the rule's scope quoted and all five prerequisites answered, and the byte-neutrality prerequisite is now satisfied by a full-binary SHA1 rather than by an isolated score. If it is needed: tools/spelling_enum.py + sweep_variants.py over the case-1/case-2 -> selection_sound path, keeping any form that reaches 2/208 with one textual `sound = 4;`.
